findings.title: Payment Terms and Schedule
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the payment terms, including the due dates and conditions for payment under the agreement.
evidence_excerpts: Payment shall be made by Client within thirty (30) days from the date of invoice.

findings.title: Late Payment Penalties
findings.rationale: The contract specifies the penalties for late payments, including interest rates and conditions for suspension of deliveries.
evidence_excerpts: Late payments shall attract interest at 1.5% per month, calculated from the due date until the date of actual payment.

findings.title: Pricing Structure Defined
findings.rationale: The agreement explicitly outlines the pricing structure for products and services provided by the Vendor to the Client, including details on base pricing and conditions for price revisions.
evidence_excerpts: The pricing of each product is established in Table 1: Base Pricing, which shall be effective for the duration of this Agreement, unless modified through mutual written consent.

findings.title: Price Revision Clause Present
findings.rationale: The contract includes a clause that allows for price revisions based on inflation and changes in raw material costs, indicating a form of price escalation mechanism.
evidence_excerpts: Vendor may revise the prices annually, subject to inflation, changes in raw material costs, or new technology adoption.
